name: smwmusic-super-mario-odyssey-new-donk-city-smw-remix
title: Super Mario Odyssey - New Donk City (SMW Remix)
description:
The SMW-ish rendition of New Donk City, I made for the 72hoSPC #7 contest.

I added an option to enable or disable the noise cymbal, used on the contest, as it sounds kinda crispy. If you want to use the noise cymbal, change the "Add_Noise_Cymbal" define 1.
(it was about time)
